exposure: Increase in midwives density in family physician program
outcome: Women's awareness of benefits of natural childbirth
Women's preference for mode of delivery
cohort: 668 mothers with two-month-old children living in rural areas of Kurdistan province
finding: An increase in the density of midwives in the family physician program led to an increase in women's awareness of the benefits of natural childbirth, which was associated with a decreased preference for caesarean section, but this did not significantly impact caesarean section rates.
mod_finding: While the study found an increase in women's awareness of the benefits of natural childbirth due to increased midwife density, this did not translate to a significant change in caesarean section rates.
